Samara —

Update from the team after reviewing INF-4421 and your attachments: the acceptance event was recorded (transaction present) but the async ledger-flush job failed to write the grant to the visible wallet balance due to a schema migration that blocked the post-commit worker on 2028-04-08.

Plan:
- Ben will perform a manual reconciliation for cc-7781 first thing (manual grant script) and confirm the tokenized ledger entry.
- Engineering will deploy a fix to the worker (schema migration rollback) to prevent recurrence.
- We'll post a screenshot of the updated wallet and the issuance transaction id here when done.

ETA: manual credit application within 6 hours; engineering fix within 48 hours. If that window doesn't work for your Thursday demo, we can provision a temporary promo key as a fallback.

Attachments: (referenced) acceptance-email.eml, ledger-screenshot.png
Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4421

Apologies for the hiccup — we'll keep this high priority.

Thanks,
